im_channel_messages_description: This Agent always receives direct messages. Choose when it receives messages in channels.
im_disconnect_description: Disconnecting {providerName} stops new messages from reaching this Agent and ends active conversations. Message history is preserved.
im_every_message_description: The Agent checks every new message and decides whether to reply. This may use more tokens.
im_feishu_activation_app_help: Ask an application administrator to check that the app is published and enabled.
im_feishu_activation_app_unavailable: Waiting for the application to be enabled
im_feishu_activation_check_failed: Couldn’t check right now. Your authorization is saved and OpenTag will retry automatically.
im_feishu_activation_description: Your authorization is saved. OpenTag will connect this app automatically when it is ready. You can close this page.
im_feishu_activation_permissions_help: If enterprise approval is required, ask an administrator to review it in {provider}. All required permissions must take effect before connecting.
im_feishu_activation_runtime: Waiting for the runtime to recover
im_feishu_app_already_connected: This {provider} bot is already connected to another Agent. Choose a different bot and try again.
im_feishu_authorization_declined: {provider} authorization was declined. Try again and approve the requested permissions.
im_feishu_authorization_expired: This QR code expired. Generate a new one and try again.
im_feishu_authorization_failed: Couldn’t connect {provider}. Try scanning a new QR code.
im_feishu_authorization_mismatch: This {provider} bot does not match the current connection. Try again with the current bot, or choose Change bot.
im_feishu_create_instructions: Choose an existing {provider} Bot or create a new one, then confirm the requested permissions.
im_feishu_dialog_change_description: Scan the QR code in {provider} to choose a different bot and approve the required permissions.
im_feishu_dialog_connect_description: Scan with {provider} on your phone, then choose a bot and approve the required permissions.
im_feishu_dialog_permissions_description: Scan the QR code in {provider} and approve all required permissions for the current bot.
im_feishu_permissions_missing: {provider} permissions are incomplete. Try again and approve all requested permissions.
im_feishu_reauthorize_instructions: Confirm the updated permissions for the current {provider} Bot.
im_feishu_saved_authorization_expired: The saved authorization expired. Authorize again and select the original application.
im_feishu_saved_credential_invalid: The application credentials are no longer valid. Authorize again and select the original application.
im_feishu_setup_interrupted: {provider} setup was interrupted. Generate a new QR code and try again.
im_feishu_status_unavailable: Couldn’t load the connection status. Refresh this page to try again.
im_feishu_unavailable: {provider} is unavailable right now. Check the connection and try again.
im_group_chat_messages_description: This Agent always receives direct messages. Choose when it receives messages in group chats.
im_mentions_only_description: The Agent checks the conversation when someone @mentions it. Messages since its last reply are included for context.
im_messaging_page_description: Reach this Agent in a chat app, where it works as a digital coworker on the team.
im_receive_mode_failed: Couldn’t update the message setting. Try again.
im_slack_agent_computer_not_bound: Connect a Computer to this Agent before connecting {provider}.
im_slack_authorization_failed: Couldn’t connect {provider}. Start the connection again from this Agent.
im_slack_auto_approval_denied: Installation denied. Contact an app manager.
im_slack_auto_approval_help: Open {provider} app management and select Requests to install. Workspace Owners and designated App Managers can review requests; Workspace Admin alone does not grant this permission. Organization policies may require an organization app manager.
im_slack_auto_busy: Setup is still running. Wait, then continue.
im_slack_auto_computer_offline: Computer offline. Restore the connection or use manual setup.
im_slack_auto_create_failed: Creation failed. Check permissions or try later.
im_slack_auto_existing_manual: Use manual setup for this App.
im_slack_auto_install_failed: Connection failed. Retry with the same App.
im_slack_auto_manual_required: Refresh the connection or use manual setup.
im_slack_auto_network_failed: Check the network, then retry with the same App.
im_slack_auto_permissions: Authorize this computer to manage workspace apps. Use your own command.
im_slack_auto_unavailable: Automatic setup is unavailable. Use manual setup.
im_slack_auto_uncertain: Check existing Apps before proceeding. Do not create another copy.
im_slack_changed_required: Enter at least one credential to update.
im_slack_check_agent: Check Agent status to finish setup.
im_slack_configuration_changed: The connection changed. Reopen setup to use its latest state.
im_slack_create_instructions: Install the App, then enter its credentials.
im_slack_create_recovery: If creation stalls, check Your Apps first. If the App exists, open OAuth & Permissions → Install to workspace. If {provider} asks you to wait, retry later without creating another copy.
im_slack_credentials_unavailable: The saved credentials cannot be recovered. Disconnect and reconnect this App; history is retained.
im_slack_existing_app_instructions: If this App does not have the URL and events below, add them in {provider} without replacing its other settings. Install again if permissions changed, then update the Token.
im_slack_identity_mismatch: These credentials belong to a different App, workspace or Bot. Use the original App, or disconnect before changing Apps.
im_slack_invalid_token: {provider} could not verify this Bot Token and App. Copy the Bot User OAuth Token from the installed App and try again.
im_slack_permissions_missing: {provider} permissions are incomplete. Update permissions and try again.
im_slack_status_failed: Couldn’t read connection status. Try again.
im_slack_token_help: OAuth & Permissions → Bot User OAuth Token
im_slack_unavailable: {provider} is unavailable right now. Check the connection and try again.
im_slack_verify_instructions: In Event Subscriptions, confirm Verified and select Save Changes, then send a message.
im_slack_workspace_already_connected: This {provider} App is already connected to another Agent. Create another App for this Agent; you can use the same workspace.
